title: Vehicle Gate: Concept Definition
description:
Vehicle Gate is a speculative matter-transmission concept: scanning an object or person, converting the pattern to a transmittable form, and reconstructing it elsewhere. Signature concept-tech, not established fact.

Vehicle gates widen portal throats to highway scale so surface vehicles drive between colonies without spacecraft.

This database is the permanent archive for Vehicle Gate: its definition, three compounding model generations (Mark I, Mark II, Mark III - each better than the last), full specifications, runnable code demonstrations, applications, and safety framing. Drive-through portals for rovers and trucks.

title: Vehicle Gate: Principles and Idea Lineage
t: Vehicle Gate: Principles and Idea Lineage
description:
